messages.subject: GCC Energy Leadership Profile | Country Operations, ESG and External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sloyan,

Your work on senior, country, regional and functional leadership appointments across Middle East energy and industrial markets makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities sit where executive leadership, regulators, communities, industrial operations, investment priorities and energy transition intersect.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates. My fit is strongest in corporate, stakeholder and country-facing leadership rather than technical engineering appointments.

I would welcome consideration for suitable energy or industrial searches where institutional engagement, ESG, external affairs or country coordination form part of the leadership mandate. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
